versions.content: {DRAFT} If the Activation Line status of a DoIPInterface switches to “inactive” , the DoIP module shall shall loop over all DoIPTcpConnection, DoIPUdpConnection, and DoIPUdpVehicleAnnouncementConnections. F or each of these DoIPConnections the DoIP module shall retrieve the corresponding SoConId via call to the Specification of Diagnostic over IP AUTOSAR CP R19 - 11 22 of 129 Document ID 418 : AUTOSAR_SWS_DiagnosticOverIP - AUTOSAR confidential - SoAd_GetSoConId and close all the connection by a call to SoAd_CloseSoCon with the retrieved SoConId.

If the Activation Line status of a DoIPInterface switches to "inac- tive", the DoIP module shall shall loop over all DoIPTcpConnection, DoIPUdpConnec- tion, and DoIPUdpVehicleAnnouncementConnections. For each of these DoIPCon- nections the DoIP module shall retrieve the corresponding SoConId via call to the So Ad_GetSoConId and close all the connection by a call to SoAd_CloseSoCon with the retrieved SoConId.
